title: Antioxidant Capacity and NF-kB-Mediated Anti-Inflammatory Activity of Six Red Uruguayan Grape Pomaces.
authors: Farina, Emiliana; Daghero, Hellen; Bollati-Fogolin, Mariela; Boido, Eduardo; Cantero, Jorge; Moncada-Basualto, Mauricio; Olea-Azar, Claudio; Polticelli, Fabio; Paulino, Margot
one_liner_zh: 该文研究葡萄渣酚类抗氧化与NF-κB抗炎活性，仅含少量分子对接辅助解释，非蛋白质-DNA互作核心体系，方法深度不足。
abstract: Grape pomaces have a wide and diverse antioxidant phenolics composition. Six Uruguayan red grape pomaces were evaluated in their phenolics composition, antioxidant capacity, and anti-inflammatory properties. Not only radical scavenging methods as DPPH(.) and ABTS(.+) were employed but also ORAC and FRAP analyses were applied to assess the antioxidant potency of the extracts. The antioxidant reactivity of all extracts against hydroxyl radicals was assessed with ESR. The phenol profile of the most bioactive extract was analyzed by HPLC-MS, and a set of 57 structures were determined. To investigate the potential anti-inflammatory activity of the extracts, Nuclear Factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB) modulation was evaluated in the human colon cancer reporter cell line (HT-29-NF-kappaB-hrGFP). Our results suggest that Tannat grapes pomaces have higher phenolic content and antioxidant capacity compared to Cabernet Franc. These extracts inhibited TNF-alpha mediated NF-kappaB activation and IL-8 production when added to reporter cells. A molecular docking study was carried out to rationalize the experimental results allowing us to propose the proactive interaction between the NF-kappaB, the grape extracts phenols, and their putative anti-inflammatory bioactivity. The present findings show that red grape pomace constitutes a sustainable source of phenolic compounds, which may be valuable for pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and food industry applications.
abstract_zh: 葡萄渣具有广泛且多样的抗氧化酚类组成。对六种乌拉圭红葡萄渣的酚类组成、抗氧化能力及抗炎特性进行了评估。不仅采用了DPPH(.)和ABTS(.+)等自由基清除方法，还应用了ORAC和FRAP分析来评估提取物的抗氧化效力。所有提取物对羟基自由基的抗氧化反应性通过ESR进行了评估。最具生物活性提取物的酚类谱通过HPLC-MS分析，确定了57种结构。为研究提取物潜在的抗炎活性，在人结肠癌报告细胞系（HT-29-NF-kappaB-hrGFP）中评估了核因子kappa-B（NF-kappaB）的调节作用。我们的结果表明，与品丽珠相比，丹娜葡萄渣具有更高的酚类含量和抗氧化能力。这些提取物在添加到报告细胞中时，抑制了TNF-alpha介导的NF-kappaB激活及IL-8产生。进行了分子对接研究以合理化实验结果，使我们能够提出NF-kappaB、葡萄提取物酚类及其推定抗炎生物活性之间的主动相互作用。目前的研究结果表明，红葡萄渣构成了一种可持续的酚类化合物来源，可能对制药、化妆品和食品工业应用具有价值。
